title: Hopper campaign cell artifact
description: One JSON per (engine, model, sku, workload, concurrency, spec, think) cell. Machine-readable successor to the JSON EXAMPLE in PRD section 10, closing the gaps recorded in docs/campaigns/hopper-atlas-vs-vllm-2026-09/vllm-control/SCHEMA-GAPS.md. Three rules run through the whole file. (1) A missing measurement is null, never zero, never false-as-a-measurement, never an invented hash -- so every measured field is explicitly nullable and every gate boolean is a tri-state. (2) A percentile has to say how it was reduced: the ladder client keeps one percentile per rep and discards the per-request latencies, so a ladder-derived p50 is a mean of rep percentiles and may not be recorded as a pooled one. (3) Provenance fields are what make two runs comparable, so they are required even when their value is null-with-a-reason.
x-atlas-cross-checks-note: Conditional rules the draft-2020-12 keyword set would express with if/then. validate_artifact.py implements them by these names; adding one here without adding it there is an error the validator reports on itself.

cell_id.description: engine.model_key.sku.workload.cC.specX.thinkY -- the cell's identity and the key the compare step pairs on.

revision.description: Pinned HF snapshot revision. Null means the run did not pin one -- a manifest proving a revision exists is not evidence those bytes were loaded (SCHEMA-GAPS).

engine_version.description: The identity of the ENGINE BUILD that served the requests, and only what something verified: image_digest is the digest of the container that ran, binary_sha256 the hash of the local binary that ran, git_sha a revision the engine itself declares (an image's org.opencontainers.image.revision label, or a --version that carries one). The campaign checkout's HEAD is NOT an engine revision -- it is harness.git_sha. Each engine leaves the other's fields null rather than substituting a hash it happens to have.

harness.description: The campaign checkout that drove the cell -- run_cell.sh, the assembler, the recipes. Provenance for the harness, never for the engine: recording it as engine_version.git_sha is how an artifact came to claim a revision nothing had verified. The ladder client's hash is not repeated here; client.sha256 is its single source.

gpu.description: Product name from `nvidia-smi -q`. Null when preflight could not read one -- a cell that failed before the box was described still has to produce an artifact.

cuda.description: The container's CUDA runtime, kept distinct from the driver's advertised CUDA compatibility (SCHEMA-GAPS).

sm_clock_mhz.description: Null unless a clock was sampled under load. The ladder samples one string per rep BEFORE the batch starts; an idle reading is not a performance clock.

matched.description: True only when the paired cell ran the same tp/ep/pp/dp/world_size. A vLLM-only run cannot set this true.

recipe_max.description: True when this topology IS the recipe's rendered maximum. False marks a matched-topology cell that had to step down from recipe-max to pair with the other engine (PRD phase C stop rule).

serve_command.description: argv as executed, including the docker preamble. A reconstructed command belongs in notes, not here.

serve_env.description: Environment set for the serve process. Empty object means none was set, which for Atlas on an NVLink box is the correct NCCL configuration.

client.description: Client provenance, kept strictly separate from the engine's (SCHEMA-GAPS: the ladder's driver_sha256 is the CLIENT hash and has been mistaken for a server revision).

sha256.description: SHA256 of the client source as executed. Null if it could not be read -- never a placeholder, which would be an invented hash.

isl_nominal.description: The --isl the client was given. make_prompt() builds isl-12 filler WORDS plus a nonce and a suffix, so this is nominal, not tokenizer-exact.

isl_measured_p50.description: Median observed prompt_tokens, when usage evidence exists. Null otherwise -- the workload may not be called exactly 1024/4096 tokens without it.

penalties.description: Pinned explicitly on both engines: Atlas's non_thinking preset injects presence_penalty 1.5 when a request omits it while vLLM defaults to 0, which moved the GB10 ladder 7.8%.

timing.description: When the measured run happened, copied from the ladder JSON's own header. These are the artifact's ONLY timestamps and the ones PRD section 4's 24 h pairing window is measured across. Null when no ladder ran: a cell that failed before measurement has no measurement time, and stamping the assembly time here would make an unmeasured cell look pairable.

spec.description: Server-side speculation state, which the ladder JSON does not carry. Both-or-neither across the two legs of a pair.

first_token_s.description: Non-streaming one-token response latency including framing -- NOT the ladder's SSE TTFT.

determinism_ok.description: Two greedy runs byte-identical AND the reply is not degenerate (repetition-loop detector, bounded-answer truncation). Identical garbage is not determinism; see bench/hopper_ab/coherency_gate.py.

known_answer_ok.description: Known-answer probes (17*23=391, capital of Japan, 'refrigerator' backwards) answered in the first or last line without loop signals. null = gate predates the check (before 2026-09-05).

percentile_method.description: REQUIRED, and the reason this schema exists. bench/ladder38/harness_w55_conc_ladder.py computes a percentile per rep and discards the per-request latencies, so pooled cell percentiles cannot be reconstructed from its output. A ladder-derived value is mean_of_rep_percentiles; recording it as pooled_requests is the masquerade this field prevents.

tok_s_series.description: Raw per-rep rates, never only the mean. tok_s_mean is an unweighted mean of rep rates, not total tokens over total elapsed.

tpot_p50_ms.description: Null when unavailable. A zero TPOT arises from one content delta or a single token and is an absence, not a zero-time decode.

vacuous.description: True when any timed request returned under 80% of the output budget. Such a cell is non-comparable.

ptx_gate_receipt_sha256.description: Atlas PTX gate ledger receipt. Null for vLLM -- the Atlas custom PTX gate does not apply to an official vLLM image, and copying Atlas's ledger into a vLLM receipt would be a fabrication.

ptx_gate_not_applicable_reason.description: Required (non-empty) whenever ptx_gate_receipt_sha256 is null. Cross-check ptx_receipt_or_reason.

paired_cell.description: The other engine's cell. A cell is CERTIFIED only when this is filled in and within_24h is true (PRD section 4 A/B gate). within_24h is the verdict of the whole pairing check -- same model/SKU/workload/concurrency/spec/think on the OTHER engine, and both timing fields inside the window -- not the timestamp comparison alone; null means it could not be decided.

failing_stage.description: The stage that did not complete. Null iff the verdict is CERTIFIED. A cell whose gates all passed but whose paired cell is not yet recorded names `pair`: it is unfinished, not broken. Cross-check verdict_failing_stage.
